요한이서 1:1.content: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;

요한이서 1:2.content: For the truth’s sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.

요한이서 1:3.content: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

요한이서 1:4.content: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.

요한이서 1:5.content: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

요한이서 1:6.content: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.

요한이서 1:7.content: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.

요한이서 1:8.content: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.

요한이서 1:9.content: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.

요한이서 1:10.content: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:

요한이서 1:11.content: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.

요한이서 1:12.content: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.

요한이서 1:13.content: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
